claims.text: Its purpose, in the document: 'The purpose of this project is to provide for the immediate establishment of interrogation teams for the operational support of OSO and OPC activities. The teams will utilize the polygraph, drugs, and hypnotism to attain the greatest results in interrogation techniques.' A team is a doctor-psychiatrist, a polygraph-hypnotist and a technician, and the doctors' Washington office is to 'serve as a cover for training, experimentation, and indoctrination purposes in the use of drugs and hypnotism'.

claims.text: The founding proposal names its own irregularity: 'In view of the extreme sensitivity of this project and its covert nature, it is deemed advisable to submit this project directly to you, rather than through the channel of the Projects Review Committee. Knowledge of this project should be restricted to the absolute minimum number of persons.'

The one-year budget in the attachment totals $65,515.00: $40,800 personnel, $1,025 supplies, $3,190 equipment, $18,000 transportation and $2,500 rent, itemised down to a Keeler polygraph machine and its spare part kit.

claims.text: The founding proposal for Project BLUEBIRD went to him as Director of Central Intelligence. The memorandum of 5 April 1950 from the Chief of the CIA's Inspection and Security Staff is addressed to the Director of Central Intelligence and says on its face: 'In view of the extreme sensitivity of this project and its covert nature, it is deemed advisable to submit this project directly to you, rather than through the channel of the Projects Review Committee. Knowledge of this project should be restricted to the absolute minimum number of persons.' It asks him for approval and for an allocation of $65,515.

edges.label: Compartment created by bypassing the review committee, in writing
edges.note: The proposal states on its face that it goes directly to the Director rather than through the Projects Review Committee because of the project's sensitivity, and asks that knowledge be held to the absolute minimum number of persons.
